source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 7 summary (PDF 191).

items: “Terms of Use”, jinhein Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service bhi kehte hain, legal agreements (qanooni samjhaute) hain jo batate hain ke koi service ya product kaise istemal ho sakta hai.
Terms of Use todne ke serious legal consequences (qanooni nateeje) ho sakte hain: user par jurmana, muqadma, ya service istemal karne par pabandi.
Terms of Use ke ethical (akhlaqi) pehlu: fairness (insaf), transparency (kuch na chhupana) aur user ke rights ki respect (izzat).
Terms of Use mein personal rights: privacy ka haq, maloomat milne ka haq, aur consent (ijazat ya razamandi) wapas lene ka haq.
Spam woh unwanted messages hain jo email ya phone par aate hain.
Spyware harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wala) software hai jo chupke se dekhta hai ke aap computer ya phone par kya karte hain.
Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke device par rakh deti hain jab aap unhein kholte hain.
Phishing ek dhoka hai jis mein koi bharose wali organization (jaise bank) ban kar aap se personal maloomat nikalwata hai.
Antivirus software computer ko spyware jaise harmful programs se bachata hai.
Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke computer par store karti hain. (Kitab ne cookies ki tareef do dafa likhi hai.)
Digital divide bridge karne ka matlab hai ke sab ko technology aur internet tak barabar access (pohanch) mile.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Summary sirf chand baatein dohrati hai. Chapter mein pharming, digital divide ki causes (wajah) aur impacts (asar), maloomat parakhne ke saat qadam, computing ke positive (achhe) aur negative (bure) asar aur digital citizenship bhi hain; inhein apne apne lesson mein dekhein.
